derivation_method: Employee 12% + employer 12% (employer: 8.33% to EPS and 3.67% to the EPF account) = 24% OF BASIC WAGES (up to the statutory wage ceiling, Rs 25,000 per month from 17/09/2026), NOT a percentage of net or total household income. Dated to the statement date in the source because the releases give no start date for the rates.
source_release: PIB Release 2311548 - Cabinet raises EPF wage ceiling (PIB Raipur)
source_locator: PIB/Labour Ministry release text | Paragraph 4 from end: employee contributes 12 per cent of the basic wages; PIB/Labour Ministry release text | Same paragraph: employer also contributes an equivalent 12 per cent | Caveat: of BASIC WAGES up to the ceiling; PIB restatement (EPFO blocked)
